utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Thanks for coming in. Tell me about your sales experience.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I have been an account executive for three years selling HR software to mid-size companies.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: How do you handle a prospect who says your product is too expensive?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I usually offer a discount so we can close quickly.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Walk me through how you build your pipeline each week.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I mostly work the leads marketing gives me, and I follow up by email.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: What was your quota last year and did you hit it?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: It was 600 thousand and I got to about 540.
